form.current-chamber: IN THE SENATE OF THE UNITED STATES

action.action-desc: Mr. Tillis (for himself and Mr. Burr) introduced the following bill; which was read twice and referred to the Committee on Banking, Housing, and Urban Affairs

form.official-title: To amend the Federal Credit Union Act to remove outdated responsibilities of boards of directors of Federal credit unions.

section.text: This Act may be cited as the Credit Union Modernization Act of 2019.

section.header: Duties of boards of directors of Federal credit unions
section.text: The Federal Credit Union Act (12 U.S.C. 1751 et seq.) is amended—

paragraph.text: in section 111(b) (12 U.S.C. 1761(b)), in the second sentence, by striking credit committee, and loan officers and inserting and credit committee; and

subparagraph.text: in paragraph (1), by striking act upon applications for membership or;
in paragraph (8), by striking subchapter and inserting title;
